description.zh:
按照凭证的启停用状态进行过滤。

**true**表示启用，**false**表示停用。
description.en:
Filters join permissions by enabled or disabled status.

A value of **true** indicates enabled. A value of **false** indicates disabled.

description.zh: 模糊匹配入网凭证使用的JoinEUI。
description.en: The JoinEUI used by the join permission for fuzzy matching.

description.zh: 模糊匹配入网凭证的名称。
description.en: The name of the join permission for fuzzy matching.

description.zh: 模糊匹配入网凭证租户的阿里云账号ID。
description.en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the join permission tenant for fuzzy matching.

descriptions.zh: > 能够被用户账号“拥有”的入网凭证一定是专用入网凭证。
descriptions.en: > Join permissions that can be "owned" by a user account are always dedicated join permissions.
